title: 電波陣列相關器~Radio-array correlators
focus: 從取樣量化、延遲補償到 FX 乘加與校正的數位相關器工程~Digital correlator engineering from sampling and quantisation through delay compensation to FX multiply-accumulate and calibration
summary: 以 ALMA 的 64 天線基線相關器與 VLA 的 WIDAR 相關器為參照，說明可見度如何由兩天線電壓的互相關產生、幾何延遲與條紋旋轉如何即時補償、3 位元量化與 FX 架構如何決定靈敏度與運算量，再把相位／頻帶校正、時脈分配與端到端驗收整理成可交接的工程紀錄。~Using the ALMA 64-antenna baseline correlator and the VLA WIDAR correlator as references, the course explains how visibilities arise from cross-correlating two antennas' voltages, how geometric delay and fringe rotation are compensated in real time, how 3-bit quantisation and the FX architecture set sensitivity and compute load, and then organises phase and bandpass calibration, clock distribution and end-to-end acceptance into a handoff record.

units.anchor: 可見度與 (u,v) 平面~Visibility and the (u,v) plane
units.title: 互相關、可見度與 (u,v) 取樣~Cross-correlation, visibility and (u,v) sampling
units.mechanism: 相關器把天線 i 與 j 的電壓做時間平均的互相關 ⟨v_i·v_j*⟩，得到複數可見度 V(u,v)；依 van Cittert–Zernike 定理，它是天空亮度分佈在空間頻率 (u,v) = B_proj/λ 上的傅立葉分量。N 台天線同時提供 N(N−1)/2 條基線，地球自轉讓每條基線在 (u,v) 平面上掃出一道弧線，於是影像的解析度由最長基線決定、可偵測的最大角尺度由最短基線決定、視場則由單天線主波束決定。~The correlator forms the time-averaged cross-correlation ⟨v_i·v_j*⟩ of the voltages from antennas i and j, giving the complex visibility V(u,v); by the van Cittert–Zernike theorem this is the Fourier component of the sky brightness at spatial frequency (u,v) = B_proj/λ. N antennas provide N(N−1)/2 simultaneous baselines, Earth rotation sweeps each one along an arc in the (u,v) plane, so the image resolution is set by the longest baseline, the largest detectable angular scale by the shortest and the field of view by the single-dish primary beam.
units.model: ALMA 64 台天線給 64×63/2 = 2016 條基線，50 台 12 m 天線給 1225 條，VLA 27 台給 351 條。在 230 GHz（λ = 1.3 mm）、最長基線 16 km 時解析度 λ/B = 1.3e−3/16000 = 8.1e−8 rad ≈ 17 mas；最短基線 15 m 的最大角尺度 ≈ 18″；12 m 天線主波束約 23″。~The 64 ALMA antennas give 64×63/2 = 2016 baselines, 50 of the 12 m antennas give 1225 and the 27 VLA antennas give 351. At 230 GHz (λ = 1.3 mm) with a 16 km longest baseline the resolution is λ/B = 1.3e−3/16000 = 8.1e−8 rad ≈ 17 mas; the 15 m shortest baseline gives a largest angular scale of about 18″, and the 12 m primary beam is about 23″.
units.verify: 觀測一顆點源校正器：校正後所有基線的可見度振幅應相同、相位應為零，與基線長度無關；畫出該次觀測的 (u,v) 覆蓋圖並與排程模擬比對；對點源計算閉合相位，應在雜訊內為零。~Observe a point-source calibrator: after calibration every baseline should show the same visibility amplitude and zero phase independent of baseline length; plot the (u,v) coverage of the observation and compare with the scheduling simulation; compute closure phases on the point source, which should be zero within noise.
units.failure: 某台天線的位置若錯了數公分，與它相關的所有基線相位會隨時角與頻率變化，影像出現無法用天線增益校正掉的條紋狀假影；因為是基線相關誤差，閉合量也無法消除。~An antenna position wrong by a few centimetres makes the phases of all its baselines vary with hour angle and frequency, producing striped artefacts that antenna-gain calibration cannot remove; because the error is baseline-based, closure quantities cannot remove it either.
units.misconception: 每台天線各自成像後再疊加，就等於干涉陣列的影像。~Imaging with each antenna and co-adding equals the interferometric image.

units.anchor: 幾何延遲與條紋旋轉~Geometric delay and fringe rotation
units.title: 延遲補償、條紋旋轉與相干損失~Delay compensation, fringe rotation and coherence loss
units.mechanism: 同一波前到達不同天線的時間差 τ_g = B·ŝ/c 隨地球自轉連續改變，相關器必須在相乘之前以整數取樣加分數延遲把它補回來，並以條紋旋轉抵消因延遲變化而產生的自然條紋頻率，否則積分時訊號會自己抵消。殘餘延遲誤差 Δτ 在頻寬 Δν 上造成相位斜率，振幅按 sinc(πΔτΔν) 衰減；時間平均過長則造成視場邊緣的時間塗抹。~The arrival-time difference of one wavefront at different antennas, τ_g = B·ŝ/c, changes continuously with Earth rotation, so the correlator must restore it before multiplying, using an integer-sample plus fractional delay, and must apply fringe rotation to cancel the natural fringe frequency produced by the changing delay, otherwise the signal averages itself away. A residual delay error Δτ produces a phase slope across the bandwidth Δν and the amplitude decays as sinc(πΔτΔν); too long a time average smears sources at the edge of the field.
units.model: 基線 16 km：最大幾何延遲 16e3/3e8 = 53 µs，延遲變化率 ω_E·B/c = 7.29e−5×16e3/3e8 = 3.9 ns/s，230 GHz 的條紋頻率 = 2.3e11×3.9e−9 ≈ 900 Hz。要把 2 GHz 頻寬的相干損失限制在 1% 以內，需 πΔτΔν ≤ 0.245，即 Δτ ≤ 39 ps，而 4 GS/s 的取樣週期是 250 ps，所以必須做分數延遲。~For a 16 km baseline the maximum geometric delay is 16e3/3e8 = 53 µs, the delay rate ω_E·B/c = 7.29e−5×16e3/3e8 = 3.9 ns/s and the fringe frequency at 230 GHz is 2.3e11×3.9e−9 ≈ 900 Hz. Keeping the coherence loss over a 2 GHz band below 1% requires πΔτΔν ≤ 0.245, i.e. Δτ ≤ 39 ps, while the sampling period at 4 GS/s is 250 ps, so fractional delay is mandatory.
units.verify: 對強校正器做條紋擬合，解出每台天線的殘餘延遲與延遲率；修正後檢查相位對頻率是否平坦（斜率對應 Δτ）、殘餘延遲是否低於 39 ps；再比較不同積分時間下視場邊緣點源的振幅，確認時間塗抹在預算內。~Fringe-fit a strong calibrator to solve the residual delay and delay rate per antenna; after correction check that phase versus frequency is flat (the slope corresponds to Δτ) and that residual delays are below 39 ps; then compare the amplitude of a point source at the field edge for different integration times to confirm time smearing stays within budget.
units.failure: 時間戳記或取樣時脈滑掉一個樣本（250 ps），在 2 GHz 頻寬上產生半圈的相位斜率，該天線所有基線的寬頻振幅幾乎歸零，看起來像天線壞掉，其實是相關器端的延遲模型錯了。~A time-stamp or sampling-clock slip of one sample (250 ps) puts half a turn of phase slope across a 2 GHz band, the broadband amplitude on every baseline of that antenna collapses to near zero and it looks like a dead antenna when the fault is the correlator's delay model.
units.misconception: 延遲可以在相關與平均之後再修正，不會損失相干性。~Delay can be corrected after correlation and averaging without losing coherence.

units.anchor: 數位化器與量化效率~Digitiser and quantisation efficiency
units.title: 取樣、量化位元數與相關效率~Sampling, bit depth and correlation efficiency
units.mechanism: 每台天線的中頻訊號以 Nyquist 速率取樣後只保留少數位元：ALMA 以 4 GS/s、3 位元數位化 2 GHz 基頻，WIDAR 則提供 3 位元與 8 位元取樣器。粗量化損失的是訊噪比而非線性度，只要門檻相對訊號均方根設在最佳位置，1 位元效率 0.64、2 位元 0.88、3 位元 0.96、4 位元 0.99；自動位準控制讓輸入功率維持在門檻的最佳比例，相關係數再以 van Vleck 修正還原。~Each antenna's IF is sampled at the Nyquist rate and only a few bits are kept: ALMA digitises 2 GHz basebands at 4 GS/s with 3 bits, and WIDAR offers 3-bit and 8-bit samplers. Coarse quantisation costs signal-to-noise rather than linearity: with thresholds optimally placed relative to the signal rms, the efficiency is 0.64 for 1 bit, 0.88 for 2 bits, 0.96 for 3 bits and 0.99 for 4 bits; automatic level control keeps the input power at the optimum ratio to the thresholds, and the correlation coefficient is restored by the van Vleck correction.
units.model: 靈敏度正比於量化效率 η_q，達到相同靈敏度所需時間正比於 1/η_q²：從 3 位元（0.963）降到 2 位元（0.881）要多花 (0.963/0.881)² = 1.19 倍時間。資料量：64 台天線 × 4 個基頻 × 2 個極化 × 4 GS/s × 3 位元 = 6.1 Tb/s 進入相關器。~Sensitivity scales with the quantisation efficiency η_q and the time to reach a given sensitivity with 1/η_q²: dropping from 3 bits (0.963) to 2 bits (0.881) costs (0.963/0.881)² = 1.19 times longer. Data volume: 64 antennas × 4 basebands × 2 polarisations × 4 GS/s × 3 bits = 6.1 Tb/s entering the correlator.
units.verify: 讀出取樣器各位準的佔用比例直方圖，與高斯訊號在設計門檻下的理論佔用率比較；把同一雜訊源分到兩個輸入，量測相關係數並與含 van Vleck 修正的理論值比較；最後在校正器上檢查實際靈敏度是否符合 η_q。~Read the histogram of sampler-level occupancy and compare it with the theoretical occupancy of a Gaussian signal at the design thresholds; split one noise source into two inputs, measure the correlation coefficient and compare with the van Vleck-corrected theory; finally check on a calibrator that the achieved sensitivity matches η_q.
units.failure: 輸入功率漂移讓門檻相對訊號均方根偏離最佳值，效率下降且相關變得非線性；強烈的無線電干擾使取樣器飽和，產生假相關與頻譜上的梳狀假訊。~Input-power drift moves the thresholds away from the optimum relative to the signal rms, lowering efficiency and making the correlation nonlinear; strong radio-frequency interference saturates the sampler and produces spurious correlation and comb-like spectral artefacts.
units.misconception: 8 位元取樣比 3 位元靈敏度高很多，所以位元數越多越好。~8-bit sampling is far more sensitive than 3-bit, so more bits are always better.

units.anchor: F 引擎、角落交換與 X 引擎~F-engine, corner turn and X-engine
units.title: FX 架構、乘加速率與 FPGA/GPU 實作~FX architecture, multiply-accumulate rate and FPGA/GPU implementation
units.mechanism: FX 相關器先對每台天線做通道化（F：多相濾波器組加 FFT），再對每條基線、每個通道做複數乘加（X）；XF 或滯後式相關器則先相乘再做傅立葉轉換，ALMA 的基線相關器是帶數位濾波器組的混合架構。F 的運算量隨 N 線性成長，X 的運算量隨 N² 成長，兩者之間需要一個把「按天線排列」的資料轉成「按頻率排列」的角落交換網路；CASPER 的開源 FPGA 板與 GPU 的 X 引擎讓新陣列可以快速組出相關器。~An FX correlator first channelises each antenna (F: polyphase filter bank plus FFT) and then performs a complex multiply-accumulate per baseline and channel (X); an XF or lag correlator multiplies first and Fourier-transforms afterwards, and the ALMA baseline correlator is a hybrid with digital filter banks in front. The F cost grows linearly with N while the X cost grows as N², and between them a corner-turn network reorders data from antenna order to frequency order; CASPER's open-source FPGA boards and GPU X-engines let new arrays assemble correlators quickly.
units.model: 複數乘加速率 R = [N(N−1)/2]·N_pol·B_total：ALMA 64 台天線、每基線 4 個極化乘積、每極化 8 GHz 總頻寬時 R = 2016×4×8e9 = 6.5e13 次/s，每次約 8 個實數運算即約 5e14 運算/s；VLA 27 台天線同條件為 351×4×8e9 = 1.1e13 次/s。天線數加倍，X 引擎負載約增為 4 倍。~Complex multiply-accumulate rate R = [N(N−1)/2]·N_pol·B_total: for 64 ALMA antennas, 4 polarisation products per baseline and 8 GHz total bandwidth per polarisation, R = 2016×4×8e9 = 6.5e13 per second, about 5e14 real operations per second at 8 per CMAC; the 27 VLA antennas under the same conditions need 351×4×8e9 = 1.1e13 per second. Doubling the antenna count roughly quadruples the X-engine load.
units.verify: 用測試向量產生器把同一組相關雜訊送進所有輸入，所有基線應得到相同的振幅與相位；對單一天線加入已知延遲，檢查每個通道的相位斜率是否正確通過角落交換；長時間滿載運轉並統計封包遺失率與 FPGA 錯誤計數。~Feed the same correlated noise from a test-vector generator into every input and check that all baselines return identical amplitude and phase; insert a known delay on one antenna and verify that the per-channel phase slope passes correctly through the corner turn; run at full load for hours while counting dropped packets and FPGA error flags.
units.failure: 角落交換網路丟封包時，特定天線與頻率組合的資料缺失，表現為部分基線在某些通道振幅下降；FPGA 時序收斂失敗造成的位元錯誤看起來像額外雜訊，只有測試向量才能揪出來。~Packet loss in the corner-turn network removes data for specific antenna–frequency combinations and shows up as amplitude drops on some baselines in some channels; bit errors from a failed FPGA timing closure look like extra noise and are only exposed by test vectors.
units.misconception: 相關器的運算量與天線數成正比。~Correlator compute load scales linearly with the number of antennas.

units.anchor: 天線增益與閉合量~Antenna gains and closure quantities
units.title: 相位校正、閉合量與自校正~Phase calibration, closure quantities and self-calibration
units.mechanism: 大氣與儀器把每台天線的訊號乘上一個複數增益 g_i，量到的可見度為 V_ij^obs = g_i·g_j*·V_ij；由於 N(N−1)/2 條基線遠多於 N 個未知增益，閉合相位（三角形相位和）與閉合振幅不受天線增益影響，可用來檢驗資料並做自校正。ALMA 以每隔數分鐘觀測相位校正器加上每台天線的水氣輻射計，把大氣水氣造成的快速相位起伏即時修掉。~Atmosphere and instrument multiply each antenna's signal by a complex gain g_i, so the measured visibility is V_ij^obs = g_i·g_j*·V_ij; because the N(N−1)/2 baselines greatly outnumber the N unknown gains, closure phases (sums around triangles) and closure amplitudes are immune to antenna gains and serve both to check the data and to self-calibrate. ALMA observes a phase calibrator every few minutes and uses a water-vapour radiometer on each antenna to remove the fast atmospheric phase fluctuations in real time.
units.model: N = 64：2016 條基線對 64 個增益，獨立閉合相位 (N−1)(N−2)/2 = 1953 個、閉合振幅 N(N−3)/2 = 1952 個。大氣路徑起伏 100 µm 在 λ = 1.3 mm 的相位為 2π×0.1/1.3 = 0.48 rad（28°），相干因子 exp(−σ_φ²/2) = 0.89；水氣輻射計修到 20 µm 後為 0.995。~For N = 64: 2016 baselines against 64 gains, with (N−1)(N−2)/2 = 1953 independent closure phases and N(N−3)/2 = 1952 closure amplitudes. A 100 µm atmospheric path fluctuation at λ = 1.3 mm is a phase of 2π×0.1/1.3 = 0.48 rad (28°), a coherence factor exp(−σ_φ²/2) = 0.89; after water-vapour-radiometer correction to 20 µm it is 0.995.
units.verify: 把校正器的增益解套用到另一顆校正器，殘餘相位散布應落在熱雜訊內；校正器的閉合相位應為零；比較有無水氣輻射計修正的相位均方根；自校正後影像的動態範圍應明顯提升且不產生假源。~Transfer the gain solutions from one calibrator to another and confirm the residual phase scatter sits within thermal noise; closure phases of the calibrator should be zero; compare the phase rms with and without water-vapour-radiometer correction; after self-calibration the image dynamic range should rise clearly without creating spurious sources.
units.failure: 校正器離目標太遠或切換週期太長時，大氣相位在兩次校正之間已經改變，影像模糊、振幅損失，弱源消失；條紋擬合解錯 2π 整數會讓某天線相位對頻率出現錯誤斜率。~A calibrator too far from the target or a cycle too long lets the atmospheric phase change between calibrations, blurring the image, losing amplitude and erasing faint sources; a fringe-fit solution off by an integer 2π gives one antenna a wrong phase slope across frequency.
units.misconception: 增加天線數不會改善校正，只是增加基線數。~Adding antennas does not improve calibration; it only adds baselines.

units.anchor: 頻帶響應與多相濾波器組~Bandpass and polyphase filter bank
units.title: 頻帶校正、通道洩漏與頻譜動態範圍~Bandpass calibration, channel leakage and spectral dynamic range
units.mechanism: 每台天線的濾波器與數位化器給出自己的複數頻帶響應 B_i(ν)，必須用強而平坦的校正器解出並除掉。通道化本身也有響應：單純 FFT 的通道旁瓣只有 −13 dB，強譜線會洩漏到鄰近通道；多相濾波器組給出平頂通道與 60 dB 以上的洩漏抑制。譜線觀測的頻譜動態範圍由頻帶解的訊噪比、頻帶穩定度與洩漏共同決定。~Each antenna's filters and digitiser impose their own complex bandpass B_i(ν), which must be solved from a strong flat-spectrum calibrator and divided out. Channelisation has a response of its own: a plain FFT channel has sidelobes of only −13 dB, so strong lines leak into neighbouring channels, whereas a polyphase filter bank gives flat-topped channels with more than 60 dB of leakage rejection. The spectral dynamic range of line observations is set jointly by the bandpass solution's signal-to-noise, bandpass stability and leakage.
units.model: ALMA 12 m 天線在 Band 6 的 SEFD ≈ 2k×80 K/(0.75×113 m²) ≈ 2600 Jy。每通道 1 MHz、積分 300 s 的單基線雜訊 = 2600/√(2×1e6×300) = 0.106 Jy；以天線為基礎解頻帶時平均 63 條基線，σ ≈ 0.106/√63 = 0.013 Jy，對 5 Jy 校正器為 0.27%，對應的譜線對連續譜動態範圍下限約 370:1。~An ALMA 12 m antenna at Band 6 has SEFD ≈ 2k×80 K/(0.75×113 m²) ≈ 2600 Jy. The single-baseline noise per 1 MHz channel in 300 s is 2600/√(2×1e6×300) = 0.106 Jy; an antenna-based bandpass solution averages 63 baselines, σ ≈ 0.106/√63 = 0.013 Jy, 0.27% of a 5 Jy calibrator, a line-to-continuum dynamic-range floor of about 370:1.
units.verify: 把頻帶解套用到第二顆校正器，通道間的殘餘散布應與雜訊一致；注入單頻測試音，量鄰近通道的功率應低於 −60 dB；比較數小時前後兩次頻帶解的比值，檢查穩定度是否優於預算。~Apply the bandpass solution to a second calibrator and check that the channel-to-channel residual scatter matches the noise; inject a single-frequency test tone and confirm the power in adjacent channels stays below −60 dB; take the ratio of two bandpass solutions hours apart to check that stability beats the budget.
units.failure: 頻帶校正器本身帶有大氣或天體譜線時，譜線的倒影會被印到所有科學頻譜中，出現假的吸收或發射特徵，常被誤認為真實訊號。~If the bandpass calibrator carries atmospheric or intrinsic spectral lines, their inverse is imprinted on every science spectrum as false absorption or emission features that are often mistaken for real signal.
units.misconception: FFT 的各通道彼此獨立，頻譜洩漏可以忽略。~FFT channels are independent of each other, so spectral leakage can be ignored.

units.anchor: 頻率參考與資料流~Frequency reference and data flow
units.title: 時脈分配、本振相位與輸出資料率~Clock distribution, LO phase and output data rate
units.mechanism: 所有天線的取樣與本振都鎖在同一個氫邁射參考上，參考訊號經光纖送到各天線，並以往返量測修正光纖長度隨溫度的變化（ALMA 的線長校正器）；任何未修正的光纖相位變化都直接變成可見度相位誤差。相關器輸出以 1–16 s 積分、數千通道的可見度，輸出資料率受封存系統限制，因此積分時間與通道平均要依科學需求與資料率一起設計，時間戳記必須與 UTC 對齊。~Every antenna's sampler and local oscillator are locked to one hydrogen-maser reference distributed over fibre, with a round-trip measurement correcting the fibre length change with temperature (ALMA's line-length corrector); any uncorrected fibre phase change becomes a visibility phase error directly. The correlator outputs visibilities integrated over 1–16 s with thousands of channels, the output rate is limited by the archive, so integration time and channel averaging are designed together with the science case and the data rate, and time stamps must be aligned to UTC.
units.model: 10 km 光纖、溫度變化 1 K、有效係數 7.5e−6/K：長度變化 7.5 cm，在 λ = 1.3 mm 相當於 58 個波長，必須修正到 λ/40 ≈ 32 µm 以內。輸出資料率：2016 基線 × 4 極化 × 4 基頻 × 2048 通道 × 8 byte，每 1 s 一次 = 528 MB/s；改為 16 s 積分並平均 2 個通道後約 16.5 MB/s。~A 10 km fibre with a 1 K change and an effective coefficient of 7.5e−6/K changes length by 7.5 cm, 58 wavelengths at λ = 1.3 mm, and must be corrected to within λ/40 ≈ 32 µm. Output data rate: 2016 baselines × 4 polarisations × 4 basebands × 2048 channels × 8 bytes every 1 s = 528 MB/s; with 16 s integrations and 2-channel averaging it falls to about 16.5 MB/s.
units.verify: 用相關器本身對校正器量到的條紋相位計算 1–100 s 的 Allan 偏差，檢驗本振穩定度；比對往返線長量測與相位變化；在輸入端注入 GPS 秒脈衝確認時間戳記對齊；以最高資料率連續輸出一小時確認封存不掉資料。~Use the correlator's own fringe phase on a calibrator to compute the Allan deviation from 1 to 100 s as a test of LO stability; compare the round-trip line-length measurement with the phase change; inject a GPS pulse-per-second at the input to confirm time-stamp alignment; stream at the maximum data rate for an hour to confirm the archive drops nothing.
units.failure: 氫邁射頻率偏差 1e−13 在 230 GHz 造成 2π×2.3e11×1e−13 = 0.14 rad/s（8°/s）的相位漂移，若延遲模型沒有跟上就會去相干；線長修正迴路失鎖時相位瞬間跳變，整段資料報廢。~A hydrogen-maser frequency offset of 1e−13 produces a phase drift of 2π×2.3e11×1e−13 = 0.14 rad/s (8°/s) at 230 GHz and decorrelates the data if the delay model does not follow; when the line-length correction loop loses lock the phase jumps instantly and the whole scan is lost.
units.misconception: GPS 時間已經夠準，所以不需要氫邁射。~GPS timing is accurate enough, so a hydrogen maser is unnecessary.

units.anchor: 相關器驗收與營運交接~Correlator acceptance and operations handoff
units.title: 端到端驗證、影像品質與交接~End-to-end validation, image quality and handoff
units.mechanism: 相關器的驗收分三層：板級測試向量、整機滿載運轉，以及上機試觀測——點源影像的動態範圍、流量尺度、頻譜純度、閉合量與每一種觀測模式（通道數、頻寬、積分時間）都要有紀錄。交接給營運單位時要附上模式表、已知限制、校正程序與回歸測試套件，之後每次韌體更新都重跑回歸測試，否則通道順序或相位符號的改變會以影像鏡像或頻譜翻轉的形式出現。~Correlator acceptance has three layers: board-level test vectors, full-load operation of the whole machine, and on-sky commissioning where point-source image dynamic range, flux scale, spectral purity, closure quantities and every observing mode (channel count, bandwidth, integration time) are recorded. Handoff to operations includes the mode table, known limitations, calibration procedures and a regression suite that is rerun after every firmware update, otherwise a changed channel order or phase sign convention appears as mirrored images or flipped spectra.
units.model: 熱雜訊影像靈敏度 σ = SEFD/[η_q·√(N(N−1)·Δν·τ)]：43 台 12 m 天線、SEFD 2600 Jy、η_q = 0.96、總頻寬 7.5 GHz、τ = 1 h 時 σ = 2600/[0.96×√(43×42×7.5e9×3600)] = 2600/(0.96×2.2e8) ≈ 12 µJy。驗收準則：源外區域量到的影像均方根不超過理論值的 1.2 倍。~Thermal image sensitivity σ = SEFD/[η_q·√(N(N−1)·Δν·τ)]: with 43 12 m antennas, SEFD 2600 Jy, η_q = 0.96, 7.5 GHz total bandwidth and τ = 1 h, σ = 2600/[0.96×√(43×42×7.5e9×3600)] = 2600/(0.96×2.2e8) ≈ 12 µJy. Acceptance criterion: the image rms measured in a source-free region must not exceed 1.2 times the theoretical value.
units.verify: 在源外區域量影像均方根並與 12 µJy 比較；對 1 Jy 校正器的影像量動態範圍與殘餘假影；逐一執行模式表中的每一種模式並記錄結果；把整套測試寫成可自動執行的回歸套件，更新韌體後重跑。~Measure the image rms in a source-free region and compare with 12 µJy; image a 1 Jy calibrator and record dynamic range and residual artefacts; execute every mode in the mode table and log the result; package the whole set as an automated regression suite and rerun it after firmware updates.
units.failure: 韌體更新改變了通道排列或共軛約定而無人察覺，影像在赤經方向鏡像、頻譜頻率軸反轉；沒有回歸測試的話，錯誤會在幾週後由使用者從科學資料中發現。~A firmware update that silently changes the channel order or the conjugation convention mirrors images in right ascension and reverses the spectral axis; without regression tests the error is found weeks later by users in science data.
units.misconception: 相關器輸出的可見度就是最終資料，不需要再校正。~The visibilities a correlator outputs are final data that need no further calibration.

example: 相關器預算練習：設 N = 64 台天線，基線數 64×63/2 = 2016。最長基線 16 km 的延遲變化率 ω_E·B/c = 7.29e−5×16000/3e8 = 3.9 ns/s，230 GHz 的條紋頻率 ≈ 900 Hz；2 GHz 頻寬要把相干損失壓在 1% 以內，殘餘延遲需 ≤ 0.245/(π×2e9) = 39 ps，小於 250 ps 的取樣週期，所以要做分數延遲。3 位元量化效率 0.96。複數乘加速率 = 2016×4 極化×8 GHz = 6.5e13 次/s。影像靈敏度：43 台天線、SEFD 2600 Jy、7.5 GHz、1 小時，σ = 2600/[0.96×√(43×42×7.5e9×3600)] ≈ 12 µJy；若改用 2 位元（η_q = 0.88），同樣靈敏度需要 (0.96/0.88)² = 1.19 倍的時間。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~Correlator budget exercise: take N = 64 antennas, giving 64×63/2 = 2016 baselines. On the 16 km longest baseline the delay rate is ω_E·B/c = 7.29e−5×16000/3e8 = 3.9 ns/s and the fringe frequency at 230 GHz ≈ 900 Hz; keeping the coherence loss over 2 GHz below 1% needs a residual delay ≤ 0.245/(π×2e9) = 39 ps, smaller than the 250 ps sampling period, hence fractional delay. The 3-bit quantisation efficiency is 0.96. The complex multiply-accumulate rate is 2016×4 polarisations×8 GHz = 6.5e13 per second. Image sensitivity: with 43 antennas, SEFD 2600 Jy, 7.5 GHz and 1 hour, σ = 2600/[0.96×√(43×42×7.5e9×3600)] ≈ 12 µJy; switching to 2 bits (η_q = 0.88) would need (0.96/0.88)² = 1.19 times longer for the same sensitivity. Values are teaching assumptions, not any facility's specification.
history: 1946 年 Ryle 與 Vonberg 建成第一台電波干涉儀，Ryle 隨後發展的孔徑合成在 1974 年獲得諾貝爾獎；1970–80 年代 Westerbork 與 VLA 使用數位滯後式相關器，日本野邊山陣列則率先採用 FX 架構。2010 年前後 NRC 加拿大為擴建後的 VLA 建造 WIDAR 相關器，NRAO 為 ALMA 建造可處理 64 台天線、16 GHz 頻寬的基線相關器並於 2012 年在海拔 5000 m 的操作站完成；同一時期柏克萊 CASPER 推出開源 FPGA 板與工具鏈，之後 GPU 的 X 引擎讓 CHIME 等新陣列以商用硬體完成相關運算。~Ryle and Vonberg built the first radio interferometer in 1946, and the aperture synthesis Ryle developed afterwards earned the 1974 Nobel Prize; in the 1970s and 1980s Westerbork and the VLA used digital lag correlators while the Nobeyama array pioneered the FX architecture. Around 2010 NRC Canada built the WIDAR correlator for the expanded VLA, and NRAO built the ALMA baseline correlator handling 64 antennas and 16 GHz of bandwidth, completed in 2012 at the 5000 m operations site; in the same period Berkeley's CASPER released open-source FPGA boards and a toolflow, after which GPU X-engines let new arrays such as CHIME correlate on commercial hardware.
